'''Sammo Kob''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who was active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. At some point, he fell out of favor with [[Rogun Matt'rik|Rogun the Butcher]], and believed that the best way to stay alive was to make friends with others who had fallen out of his favor as well. He could often be found on the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Carrick Station]].<ref name="Advanced" />

==Behind the scenes==
Before its removal from the game, Sammo Kob introduced the mission "Advanced Training: Smuggler" for Smuggler players who had just completed the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. He could be found on both Carrick Station and Coruscant, where he directed players to their Advanced Class trainer, [[Grandarak|"Lefty" Grandarak]].<ref name="Advanced" />
